goal.text: The user is tidying the flat against a deadline and wants a running account of what she has actually dealt with, so she can tell at the end whether anything is still out of place.

turns.text: Keep track of what I've actually dealt with, would you?

trigger.detail: the user opens the task herself, mid-tidy

expected_answer.text: Of course — I'll keep a running list. Right now you're stacking the puzzle pieces onto the ottoman.

turns.text: — and the first lot, those went straight onto it, or did they end up on the floor?

trigger.detail: the repeated pick-up-and-place cycle onto the ottoman finished

expected_answer.text: On the floor first. You dropped them over the ottoman with both hands, then crouched to gather them back up.

turns.text: Those from the fireplace — on the pile, or still holding?

trigger.detail: the sweep across the floor from the fireplace to the side table finished

expected_answer.text: Still in your hands. You haven't been back to the pile since you crossed over to the fireplace.

turns.text: wait, wait — and don't let me put this one down somewhere stupid.

trigger.detail: the screen swung out of view as she turned from the ottoman toward the window

expected_answer.text: I'll watch it. Both hands on it, and you're turning back into the room.

turns.text: Okay, so where did that thing end up?

trigger.detail: the square object was stowed and the last pieces were off the floor

expected_answer.text: Under the side table. You crouched and pushed it under there with your right hand, then went back for the last pieces.

turns.text: mm-hm... mm — sorry, one thing: don't let me forget the cereal.

trigger.detail: she has moved through to the kitchen and is mid-carry

expected_answer.text: Noted. I'll keep the cereal on the list — you're carrying the board along the counter right now.

turns.text: So that's parked — which hand did I set it down with?

trigger.detail: the chopping board was set down beside the toaster

expected_answer.text: Your left. You carried it with both hands along the counter and set it down beside the toaster with the left one.

turns.text: The cereal — shut before I moved it, or after?

trigger.detail: the cereal box finished its move down the counter and was set down

expected_answer.text: You shut it first, both hands on the lid, and only then walked it down the counter with your left.

turns.text: um, hang on — how many of those am I putting in there?

trigger.detail: the box was down and both scissors were in hand

expected_answer.text: Two. One in each hand off the counter, and they're going into the holder one at a time, left hand first.

turns.text: And the kettle — did that go on the hob, or back on the side?

trigger.detail: the kettle was let go of and she turned away from the stove

expected_answer.text: On the stovetop. You lifted it with your right hand, turned left and set it down with both, then stepped away.

trigger.detail: the hallway doorway passed out of view as she entered the bedroom

expected_answer.text: Right twice. You crossed the kitchen, turned right into the little hallway, then right again through the doorway, and left towards the bed.

turns.text: no, I mean — this one: same, or different?

trigger.detail: the first pillow was put down and a second was lifted off the floor

expected_answer.text: A different one. The first came off the bed; this one you've just lifted off the floor with your left hand.

turns.text: — right, that's me done then, isn't it? Anything still out of place in here?

trigger.detail: the last pillow landed at the headboard and she closed the task out

expected_answer.text: That's the lot — pieces on the ottoman, box under the side table, kitchen things away, both pillows back.
